snippet.title: Basalt: The Cursed Vein announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Basalt is a haunted roguelite match-3 mining adventure. Dig for precious ores, battle unsettling creatures, and rebuild a town of strange, whispering residents.
The deeper you reach, the greater the rewards… though the villagers keep warning you:
Don't dig too deep!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930130/Basalt_The_Cursed_Vein/
